result.topic_en: For ponderable-matter-free space, the potential V satisfies Laplace's equation, so do its derivatives η_i'; the forces X_i are expressed as second time derivatives of displacements and as gradients of a function λ, giving λ = ∂²V/∂t², with a marginal note on light vibrations.
result.transcription:
Für den von ponderabeler Masse freien Raum ist:
$\frac{\partial^2 V}{\partial \eta_1^2}+\frac{\partial^2 V}{\partial \eta_2^2}+\frac{\partial^2 V}{\partial \eta_3^2}=0$ , da $\frac{\partial V}{\partial \eta_i} = \eta_i'$ folgt auch $\frac{\partial^2 \eta_i'}{\partial \eta_1^2}+\frac{\partial^2 \eta_i'}{\partial \eta_2^2}+\frac{\partial^2 \eta_i'}{\partial \eta_3^2}=0$
[-Also ist für $\eta_1, \eta_2, \eta_3$ [?] ... für die Gravitationsbewegungen [?]-]
$X_1 = \frac{\partial^2 \eta_1'}{\partial t^2}$ d. i. $= \frac{\partial^2 \frac{\partial V}{\partial \eta_1}}{\partial t^2}$ ferner ist $X_1 = \frac{\partial \lambda}{\partial \eta_1}$ [-also-]
$X_2 = \frac{\partial^2 \eta_2'}{\partial t^2}$ $= \frac{\partial^2 \frac{\partial V}{\partial \eta_2}}{\partial t^2}$ $X_2 = \frac{\partial \lambda}{\partial \eta_2}$
$X_3 = \frac{\partial^2 \eta_3'}{\partial t^2}$ $= \frac{\partial^2 \frac{\partial V}{\partial \eta_3}}{\partial t^2}$ $X_3 = \frac{\partial \lambda}{\partial \eta_3}$
also: $\int X_1 d\eta_1 + X_2 d\eta_2 + X_3 d\eta_3 = \frac{\partial^2 V}{\partial t^2}$ ; $\lambda = \frac{\partial^2 V}{\partial t^2}$

[Margin:]
[-Da für den Fall wo nur-]
[-Lichtbewegungen-] Statt finden [?]
die die Lichterscheinungen hervor-
bringen; ist $X_1 = X_2 = X_3 = 0$ so ist
[-offen-] allgemein, weil $X_1, X_2, X_3$

methods.what: Laplace equation for the potential V in matter-free space
Derivatives of a harmonic function are harmonic: components η_i' = ∂V/∂η_i satisfy Laplace's equation
Force components as second time derivatives of displacement components, expressed via V
Force as gradient of a potential λ
Integrating the force field identifies λ with the second time derivative of V
